settings.heading: What's Inside
settings.content: Each sachet contains 3g of pharmaceutical-grade Creatine Monohydrate. No additives, no fillers, no artificial colours — just the most researched performance supplement on the planet in its purest form.

settings.heading: How to Use
settings.content: Mix one sachet with 200–300ml of water, juice, or coffee. Take daily — timing doesn't matter much, but consistency does. Works best when taken every day, not just on training days.

settings.heading: The Science
settings.content: Creatine Monohydrate is the most researched supplement in sports nutrition history — 500+ peer-reviewed studies. It works by replenishing ATP (your muscles' primary energy currency), leading to measurable gains in strength, power, and recovery. It also crosses the blood-brain barrier, supporting cognitive function.
